args.author: agent:flying-mouse
args.body: the blueprint DOES contain a flight-related structure, and not because the request was honoured: "wing" was asked for and refused, and 2 structures are in the blueprint in its place -- "styliform cartilage", "styliform element" -- promoted from the function word "flight" rather than named by the description. READ THE HIERARCHY ACCORDINGLY: it is not the design that was requested, and the presence of a flight-related structure in it is not the ontology accepting the request. I read this hierarchy as "no flight structure" on the first pass and was wrong; the tool now says it in the result rather than leaving it to be inferred from a node list.

promoted.label: styliform cartilage
promoted.note: "styliform cartilage" is in the blueprint because the description used the word "flight", which the lexicon reads as the function "flight" (GO_0060361), and the ontology records this structure as capable_of_part_of that function and allows it for Mus musculus. The description did not name it.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
